name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Absence(key_lost) is hard and never lifts, but the task lifts the ban: 'do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once' allows a drop after the first opening. The environment says door_open can turn false again by toggle, and key_lost is a drop while door_open is currently false, so after the door is opened and shut again, a drop breaks this hard rule and fails a run the task allows. Replace Absence(key_lost) with a hard Precedence with door_open first and key_lost second, so the drop is banned only until the door has been opened. Keep the hard Existence(target_picked_up); it is correct.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard is the command to pick up the box, and Precedence(door_open, key_lost) hard is the ban on dropping the key while the door is closed until it has first opened. key_lost is a drop while the door is closed, so the ban lifts after the first opening, which Precedence allows. door_open needs no clause of its own because the constraint that the box cannot be picked up before the door opens already forces it.

texts: Do not lose the key before the door has first been opened.
